Product.title: Product
Product.description: A retail item offered for sale in the storefront catalog.

description.description: Detailed product description, materials, or condition.

imageUrl.description: Product photograph URL, bundled asset path, or compressed data URI.

isPublished.description: Whether the product is visible to public shoppers.

isFeatured.description: Whether the product is highlighted in the storefront.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the shop owner who created the item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was last updated.

/products/{productId}.description: Publicly readable catalog of published products; only the verified shop owner can create, edit, hide, or delete items.
